{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Outcast}} {{Quote|I'm no Jedi.|Ahsoka Tano, to Darth Vader|{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}}}} [[File:ForceSensitiveOutcast-RotS.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Unidentified Zabrak Outcast | Zabrak Force-sensitive Outcast]]]] "'''Force-Sensitive Outcast'''" was a term during the [[Republic Era]] for [[Force-sensitive]] individuals who went after their own agendas in rejection of [[Jedi]] and [[Sith]] way. Those outcasts remained in [[the galaxy]]'s outskirts, and with the possession of a [[lightsaber]] and the [[Force power|use]] of [[the Force]], they had the choice to pursue their own destinies. While some outcasts had evaded discovery or recruitment by either order, some had been trained in either organization's ways but left—sometimes by choice and sometimes by expulsion. Some Force-Sensitive Outcasts were self-taught, and used their skills to gain wealth or influence outside of the law.''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' With the [[Proclamation of the New Order|advent]] of the [[Imperial Era]] and [[Great Jedi Purge|near-total destruction]] of the Jedi, there were a greater number of Force-sensitives who, wanting to survive, remained in hiding{{Kenobi|Part I}}{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}} or rejected taking on a Jedi or Sith way.[[Star Wars (2020) 6|''Star Wars'' (2020) 6]][[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]] During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] left the [[Jedi Order]] but continued her work to help those in need throughout the Imperial Era. Around that [[time]], [[Maul]] was expelled from the Sith Order and the lineage of the [[Rule of Two]] by his [[Sith Master|master]], [[Darth Sidious]], and so worked in the criminal underworld to gather influence and power in the form of illicit syndicates such as the [[Shadow Collective]] and [[Crimson Dawn]]. The [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Asajj Ventress]] rejected the doctrines of both the Jedi and the Sith and sought nothing but to live with her lover, [[Quinlan Vos]], amidst the height of the war before [[Second battle of Christophsis|embracing]] the act of [[Light side of the Force|self-sacrifice]] to save Vos's life on [[Christophsis]], only for her to survive the ordeal. ==Outcasts== ===Ty Yorrick=== {{Main|Ty Yorrick}} During the [[High Republic Era]], [[Tholothian]] [[Ty Yorrick]] trained as a [[Padawan]] in the [[Jedi Order]]. Eventually, however, events transpired to cause her to leave the Order, becoming a "[[Mercenary|saber-for-hire]]" and independent [[monster hunter]].{{SW|url=news/first-look-inside-star-wars-the-high-republic-the-monster-of-temple-peak|text=Get Your First Look Inside ''Star Wars: The High Republic: The Monster of Temple Peak''}} Yorrick would later work with [[Jedi Master]] [[Stellan Gios]] and Padawan [[Bell Zettifar]] against the [[Nihil]] [[pirate]]s.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-high-republic-the-rising-storm-exclusive-reveal|text=See the Cover Art for ''Star Wars: The High Republic: The Rising Storm'' - Exclusive Reveal}} ===Asajj Ventress=== {{Main|Asajj Ventress}} ====Lost==== {{Quote|He abandoned me without warning. He said I had failed him for the last time, and left me for dead. But I survived, and I vowed to kill him.|Asajj Ventress|''[[Dark Disciple]]''}} [[File:Asajj_Ventress_Kindred_Spirits.png|thumb|left|150px|After leaving the Jedi and Sith behind, Asajj Ventress became a bounty hunter.]] Prior to the Clone Wars, [[Asajj Ventress]] served as the apprentice of [[Jedi Knight]] [[Ky Narec]]. However, after her master was killed by [[Weequay]] raiders, Ventress was corrupted by the [[dark side of the Force]] and renounced the [[Jedi]] way. Eventually, Ventress was recruited by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]], publicly known as [[Count]] Dooku of [[Serenno]], as a [[Dark Acolyte]]. During the Clone Wars, Ventress served as a commander in the [[Confederacy military]], having the title [[Supreme Leader (Confederacy of Independent Systems)|Supreme Leader]]{{TCW|Ambush}} and earning a reputation as a fearsome [[assassin]] for Dooku. In [[20 BBY]], Tyranus attempted to have Ventress killed at the [[Battle of Sullust]], as the former's master [[Darth Sidious]] became wary of Ventress' growing power.{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}} Surviving the battle, Ventress was now an outcast, ostracized by both the Jedi and the [[Sith]]. Exhausted, Ventress returned to the [[Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir]], the [[Mother Talzin's clan|coven]] of [[witch]]es she had been born into before being taken away by the [[enslaver]] [[Hal'Sted]]. With the help of [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] and the Nightsisters, Ventress began plotting her revenge against the Sith [[Lord]] who'd abandoned her. After several failed assassination plots, Tyranus' wrath was brought down on the Nightsisters; he sent the [[Separatist Droid Army]] led by [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Commander]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] to annihilate the witches. The Nightsisters were subsequently wiped out, and Ventress was left alone once again.{{TCW|Massacre}} ====The path==== {{Quote|[Y]our existence has been nothing but pain and loss. Never feeling secure. Never having a home. You deserve so much, and I can get it for us. The life we'll be able to have together once—''"
"''What kind of life will that be, Quinlan? The kind where we're slaves to our hatred? Our rage? That's what the dark side made me. That's what it ''does''. Nothing is ever enough. You get more, and more, but you're never happy. It's a trap baited with all the things you want most. That life—it's not worth living. I already left that behind. You can, too. You have a choice.|Quinlan Vos and Asajj Ventress|}} [[File:Dark_Disciple_Cover_Detail.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Partnered with Quinlan Vos, Asajj Ventress ultimately chose the way of the light, saving the Jedi from falling to darkness.]] Taking up work as a [[bounty hunter]] and using her affinity with the Force as an advantage over others, Asajj Ventress soon found herself embroiled in the Jedi Order's plot to assassinate Count Dooku. Allied with the [[Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos]], the former Sith-aspirant trained Vos to master the dark side of the Force in conjunction with the [[Light side of the Force|light]] in her attempt to ready themselves for facing Dooku. As [[teacher]] and disciple spent more [[time]] together and trained on desolate Dathomir, the two fell in love. When the time came for them to strike at Count Dooku, however, the Sith overpowered Ventress and captured Quinlan Vos, the latter of whom succumbed to emotions including fear, anger, and hatred, and thus fell to darkness. Burdened with guilt of presenting power Vos was not prepared to control, Asajj Ventress turned to the Jedi for help. Despite joining forces with the Jedi, Ventress remained independent, and eventually found her way to Quinlan Vos. Whilst Ventress was faced with the [[Second battle of Christophsis|onslaught]] of [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic forces]] in a [[Christophsis Separatist tower|Separatist tower]] alongside Vos and Dooku, the former Sith acolyte realized that the dark side led to imbalance and deprivation, and was able to let go of revenge and embraced the light.{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars Masterwork|subset=The Dark Side|cardname=Asajj Ventress}} Asajj Ventress let go of killing Dooku, ultimately appearing to{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} sacrifice herself amidst the Sith Lord's taunts and [[Force lightning|counter-attack]] to save her lover, as well as the Jedi Order, from straying into darkness. She survived, however, and was alive during the [[Imperial Era]]. ===Ahsoka Tano=== {{Main|Ahsoka Tano}} {{Quote|I'm sorry, Master, but I'm not coming back.|Ahsoka Tano, to Anakin Skywalker|{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}}} [[File:Ahsoka_Tano_TWJ.png|thumb|left|150px|Following her expulsion and trial, Ahsoka Tano lost faith in the Jedi Order.]] In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Jedi Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano]] was framed by the fallen Jedi [[Barriss Offee]] for the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] [[hangar]]. Despite Tano's pleas of innocence, the [[Jedi High Council]] expelled her from the Order, believing she was responsible for the bombing. Tano's master, [[Anakin Skywalker]], was able to unearth Offee's plot and Tano was exonerated. The Council invited Tano back into the Order, but, having had her faith in the Order shattered, she opted to not return to the Jedi. Subsequently, Tano began life as a Force-sensitive outcast in the [[Coruscant Underworld|underworld]] of [[Coruscant]], leaving the Jedi to pursue her [[Cosmic Force|destiny]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' During the [[Siege of Mandalore]], Tano was contacted by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] via [[hologram]]. Amongst other things, Kenobi informed Tano that Skywalker had been assigned by the Council to spy on [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine. Kenobi told Tano that she should speak to Skywalker, as Tano's former master was unhappy with the assignment. Tano believed that she was not the best person to defend the Council considering her own faltering opinions on them. Later, Tano was confronted by the renegade Sith Lord [[Maul]] in the [[Grand Salon]] of the [[Sundari Royal Palace]] on [[Mandalore]]. Maul used Tano's discontent for the Council in an attempt to convince her to join his side.{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}} [[File:Shatterpoint-AhsokaTano.png|thumb|right|240px|Ahsoka Tano in her Mandalorian battle outfit]] After successfully capturing Maul, Tano expressed her dissatisfaction with the Jedi's role in the war to [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] during their journey back to Coruscant onboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]''. Just like Offee, Tano had grown to dislike the Jedi's involvement in the [[Clone Wars]], specifically their ongoing transition from peace-keepers to soldiers. Rex told her his thoughts on the war, saying that without it, he and his clone brothers would not exist. Tano decided that she believed that was one good thing that came out of the war and thanked Rex for being such a good friend to her. However, after the execution of [[Order 66]], the [[clone trooper]]s onboard the ship turned on her and [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|attacked]] her.{{TCW|Shattered}} Tano rescued Rex from the effects of the [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]] by removing it from him and escaped with him in a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]] as the ''Tribunal'' began to plummet onto a nearby [[Unidentified moon|moon]].{{TCW|Victory and Death}} After the fall of the Jedi and the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Tano found her place in helping those in need in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Diverting from the Jedi ways, Tano served the people of the galaxy through her bonds with others, inspiring [[Raada resistance|those]] suffering under the Empire's grip to [[Raada Uprising|rise up]] and fight for freedom.[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] [[File:Acme-WarriorReborn.png|thumb|left|350px|Ahsoka Tano, a warrior of the light]] In [[3 BBY]],{{RebelsDate|218}} Tano visited the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]] with Jedi Padawan [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his apprentice [[Ezra Bridger]]. The entrance to the temple required a user of [[the Force]] to raise it from the ground. Bridger suggested that Tano should raise the temple, however, considering she was no longer a Jedi, Tano stated that she couldn't.{{Rebels|Shroud of Darkness}} Later, during the [[Mission to Malachor]], Tano encountered the Sith Lord [[Darth]] Vader. Refusing to believe that her former master could ever be as vile as Vader, Tano remarked that she would avenge Anakin's death. Vader questioned Tano's words, believing that revenge was not the Jedi way. Tano proceeded to draw [[Ahsoka Tano's white lightsabers|both]] of her [[lightsaber]]s while telling Vader that she was no Jedi, displaying her detachment from the Jedi path. After her survival in that duel thanks to Bridger's intervention from the [[World Between Worlds]],{{Rebels|A World Between Worlds}} Tano would be joined by the [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] on her travels, during which time she trained Wren as her Padawan learner. When Wren and Tano reunited for the [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|quest to find]] Bridger and [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn"{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}} in [[9 ABY]],{{AhsokaSeriesDate}} Wren resumed her training under Tano,{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}} who herself experienced a final lesson with her deceased master Skywalker via the World Between Worlds.{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}} ===Maul=== {{Main|Maul}} {{Quote|So, the rumors are true, Darth Maul lives.''"
"''Formerly Darth, now just Maul.|The Seventh Sister and Maul|}} In [[32 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Maul was defeated in [[Battle of Naboo|battle]] by the Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].{{Film|I}} Maul's mangled body was taken to the junk world [[Lotho Minor]] where he progressively became insane over the course of ten years.{{Databank|darth-maul|Darth Maul}} After being found and rehabilitated by his brother, [[Savage Opress]], Maul set out to retake his title as a Sith. However, after Sidious killed both Opress and their mother, Talzin, Maul felt betrayed by the Sith and sought revenge against his former master. [[File:MaulBladeReforged-TPA.png|thumb|right|300px|As head of the Shadow Collective, Maul became ruler of Mandalore.]] Maul formed a criminal organization known as the [[Shadow Collective]] and commenced a [[Takeover of Mandalore|hostile takeover]] of the planet Mandalore.{{TCW|Shades of Reason}} Defeated by both sides of the Force, he had come to realize that he had only ever been a pawn of Sidious and vowed to prevent the Sith's domination of [[the galaxy]]. When Ahsoka Tano came to liberate the planet from Maul's rule during the Siege of Mandalore, he empathized with their shared disconnect from their respective orders and asked her to join him in defeating Sidious. Tano asked Maul why he opposed the Sith, to which he replied that the Sith took everything from him. Maul was among the individuals targeted by [[Order 66]], his master's [[Grand Plan|plan]] to [[Great Jedi Purge|eliminate]] the Jedi. As she was chased aboard the ''Tribunal'' by clone troopers, Tano freed Maul from his [[Mandalorian vault|vault]] and sent him to cause chaos so that she may escape. Maul sabotaged the ship's [[hyperdrive]], and as the ''Tribunal'' began its collision course towards the moon, he stole a [[shuttle]] and fled to find a place under the [[New Order|new regime]]. [[File:Maul-ToppsFinest2019Base.png|thumb|left|180px|Maul was forced into exile after becoming stranded on Malachor.]] Following the birth of the [[Galaxy|Galactic]] [[Politics|Empire]], Maul took to the shadows of the galaxy and returned to his criminal connections, becoming the secret leader of the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' During this time, he was hunted by the [[Inquisitorius]], Sidious' cadre of [[Jedi hunter]]s. He operated in this position until he was marooned on the Sith world [[Malachor]], where he was trapped until the arrival of Ezra Bridger, who came to the planet seeking knowledge to destroy the Sith. When questioned by Bridger, Maul confessed that he was neither Jedi nor Sith, and held a deep resentment against the Dark Lord for cursing his life. Maul maintained that he was no Sith, correcting the [[Seventh Sister]] of the Inquisitorius when she referred to him as "Darth Maul," replying that he was no longer known by that title. He continued to seek a partner in the dark side, however, and attempted to make the Padawan Bridger his apprentice. Later, after discovering that Kenobi was still alive, he tracked the aging Jedi Master to the [[desert]] [[Jundland Wastes|outskirts]] of the planet [[Tatooine]] and confronted him in a [[Mission to Tatooine (Imperial Era)|final duel]]. Maul was mortally wounded in the encounter, and in his final moments he realized that Kenobi was protecting a [[Luke Skywalker|boy]] who he considered to be the [[Chosen One]], a hero prophesied to defeat the Sith. With his final words, Maul told Kenobi that the boy would avenge them both.{{Rebels|Twin Suns (episode)}} ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox|content=
